$comment: Supplier catalogues verified by fetching them, not by assumption. Every entry returned a machine readable product list containing building materials when probed on 2026-10-31. Registration is not trust: the scanner still has to match each product to a material, and one catalogue observation does not become a price until a second witness or an admin approval arrives. Regenerate with scripts/price-scan/probe-catalogues.mjs. Tool nouns are excluded from the building count, because a paint sprayer is not paint.
